product.name: TerraGear TrailBlaze 30L Hiking Pack
product.description: The TerraGear TrailBlaze 30L Hiking Pack is engineered for day‑trip and multi‑day treks. A durable nylon shell with a breathable mesh back panel keeps the pack light and comfortable, while a padded shoulder strap system distributes weight evenly. The pack features a main compartment with a zippered organizer pocket, two side mesh pockets for water bottles, and a top‑load access panel for quick retrieval of gear. Integrated compression straps and a detachable rain cover add versatility. Ideal for hikers who need a reliable, weather‑resistant pack that balances capacity with ergonomic design.
